source_policy: Free publicly viewable webpage only; no paid API.
source_methodology: FootyStats states its J1 xG formula combines shot accuracy, shot frequency, attack dangerousness, possession and attack pressure; these values are provider-specific, not official J.League xG.
source_access_status: GitHub Actions request was blocked with HTTP 403; 11 values below were transcribed from the publicly rendered page and mapped by unique home/away teams and score. Source display dates can differ from J.League local match dates, so team pair and score were jointly checked.
xga_rule: home_xga = away_xg; away_xga = home_xg for the same match, from the same provider.
missing_policy: Uncovered matches remain blank; no score-based or model-based imputation.
